teaser: Six in the morning, the coffee already poured, the day's agenda running before the day officially starts. Life path 22 carries the name Master Builder, and the Executive sits inside those four letters, ESTJ. Crossed, this is a life that keeps asking for something solid raised in the world, and a temperament built to raise it. The ambition here is not private; it shows up in rooms, in rosters, in whatever gets finished before anyone else notices it was unfinished. What else sets this crossing apart is the size of what gets attempted, and how little drama attends the attempting.
excerpt: A rental car on a highway, the GPS recalculating twice before anyone admits the turn was missed.
